title: Make your home energy-efficient
tagline: Lower bills, a better label, grants claimed and the works financed.
trigger: Home owner whose energy bill jumped, or who bought a house in the last 18 months.

steps.title: Where does your energy money go?
steps.description: KBC reads your energy bills and compares them with similar homes.
steps.why: Your bills are already in your KBC transactions.
steps.result: Your energy costs went from about €{energy_before} to €{energy_after} a month. The roof loses the most heat.

steps.title: Independent energy advice
steps.description: An Encon advisor tells you which works pay back first.
steps.why: Independent advice: Encon does not sell the works.

win.customer: The right works in the right order

steps.result: Advice: roof insulation first, then a heat pump. Expected saving: about €640 a year.

steps.title: Quotes from vetted contractors
steps.description: Three comparable quotes for the chosen works, from contractors KBC checked.
steps.why: Contractors checked for registration and insurance; they see the house and the works only.
steps.result: 3 quotes received. Best: €11,800 for roof insulation, works can start in 5 weeks.

steps.title: Solar panels and a battery?
steps.description: KBC calculates whether panels and a battery pay off on your roof and consumption.
steps.why: Calculated on your own consumption, inside KBC.

win.customer: A clear payback, no sales pitch

steps.result: 8 panels (3.2 kWp) pay back in about 7 years. A battery doesn't pay off yet for you.

steps.title: Finance the works
steps.description: An energy loan for the quote you accepted, paid directly to the contractor.
steps.why: The quote is already in your file.

win.customer: Works start now, savings stay intact

steps.result: Energy loan of €11,800 approved. The monthly repayment is lower than the expected energy saving.

steps.title: A cheaper energy contract
steps.description: Join the group purchase of electricity and gas.
steps.why: Group purchasing power, organised by KBC.
steps.result: Registered for the next group purchase. Expected saving: about €180 a year.
